name: regulation-mcq-tools
description: Keep a multiple-choice question bank in line with a regulation, code, standard or policy. Compare two editions and flag affected questions (regulation-mcq-impact), update the questions to the new edition (mcq-updater), verify a bank against one edition (regulation-mcq-verify), or run all three in order (mcq-update-pipeline). Every run is saved in a numbered Outcomes folder with copies of its inputs.
